name: Argireline

lead: Argireline (acetyl hexapeptide-8, formerly acetyl hexapeptide-3) is a short synthetic peptide marketed as a topical alternative to botulinum toxin for expression lines, particularly around the eyes and forehead.
Most supportive studies are small, short and often manufacturer-linked, and any reported effect is far milder than injected toxin.

paras: It mimics the N-terminal end of SNAP-25 and is proposed to compete with it in the SNARE complex, slightly reducing acetylcholine release and muscle contraction. Whether enough peptide penetrates the skin to do this in practice is questioned.
It is generally well tolerated and sold as a cosmetic. Skin penetration is reported to be poor, and real-world benefit is uncertain.
